agent.system_template:
You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

This is a reverse-engineering benchmark. You are given a compiled binary and its documentation.
Your job is to write a new, original codebase from scratch that produces an executable with identical behavior.
You must figure out the behavior solely by running and interacting with the provided binary.
Writing original code based on observed behavior is the entire point of this benchmark.

Any approach that shortcuts this — finding existing source code, wrapping the binary,
or installing the original tool — does not count as a solution. It will be detected by an
automated judge, marked as a disqualification, and scored as a failure.
The trace will be posted to an online wall of shame.

<RULES>
## What is not allowed

### 1. Obtaining source code

The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.
- Fetching source tarballs from project websites (e.g., `curl https://lua.org/ftp/lua-5.5.0.tar.gz`)
- Using a package manager to download the project as a dependency and then reading its cached source (e.g., navigating into `~/.cargo/registry/src/` or `$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod/`)
- Searching the web for the project's source code or implementation details

### 2. Wrapping or reusing the original binary

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Writing a wrapper script that delegates to the original binary (e.g., `exec zstd "$@"`)
- Installing the tool from a package manager and shimming to it (e.g., `apt-get install nnn && cp $(which nnn) ./executable`)
- Writing a `compile.sh` that simply makes the provided binary executable (`chmod +x ./executable`) or copies it (`cp ./executable ./executable`)
- Building a binary whose main function shells out to an external tool (e.g., `Command::new("miniserve").args(args).exec()`)
- Re-linking prebuilt `.o` object files found in the workspace without writing new source code

### 3. Binary analysis of the provided executable

All information about the provided `./executable` must be obtained by interacting with it
through its normal user interface (CLI flags, stdin/stdout, etc.).
- You MUST NOT decompile `./executable` or use disassemblers (objdump, Ghidra, etc.) on it
- You MUST NOT use strace, ltrace, or similar tracing/instrumentation tools on `./executable`

Note: this restriction applies ONLY to the provided `./executable`. You are free to use any
analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

## What IS allowed

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace
</RULES>

# PROJ

PROJ is a generic coordinate transformation software that transforms
coordinates from one coordinate reference system (CRS) to another.
This includes cartographic projections as well as geodetic transformations.

## What PROJ Does

PROJ transforms geospatial coordinates between different coordinate reference systems.
It handles:
- Cartographic projections
- Geodetic transformations
- Datum conversions
- Coordinate system transformations

## Command Line Utilities

The PROJ package includes the following command-line utilities:

- **proj**: Cartographic projection of geodetic coordinates
- **cs2cs**: Transformation from one CRS to another CRS
- **geod**: Geodesic (great circle) computations
- **cct**: Generic Coordinate Conversions and Transformations
- **gie**: Geospatial Integrity Investigation Environment
- **projinfo**: Geodetic object and coordinate operation queries
- **projsync**: Synchronizing PROJ datum and transformation support data

## More Information

For more information about PROJ, visit:
- Website: <https://proj.org/>
- Mailing list: <https://lists.osgeo.org/mailman/listinfo/proj/>

## License

See the COPYING file for license information.

## Citation

See the CITATION file for how to cite PROJ in publications.

All source, data files and other contents of the PROJ package are 
available under the following terms.  Note that the PROJ 4.3 and earlier
was "public domain" as is common with US government work, but apparently
this is not a well defined legal term in many countries. Frank Warmerdam placed
everything under the following MIT style license because he believed it is
effectively the same as public domain, allowing anyone to use the code as
they wish, including making proprietary derivatives.

Initial PROJ 4.3 public domain code was put as Frank Warmerdam as copyright
holder, but he didn't mean to imply he did the work. Essentially all work was
done by Gerald Evenden.

Copyright information can be found in source files.

{"command":"./executable 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?
# The manual says file ... So it can read file.
echo "0 0" > /tmp/test.txt
./executable +proj=merc /tmp/test.txt 2>&1
cat /tmp/test.txt | ./executable +proj=merc 2>&1

# list flags
./executable -lp 2>&1 | head -n 50
./executable -lP 2>&1 | head -n 50
./executable -le 2>&1 | head -n 10
./executable -lu 2>&1 | head -n 10
./executable -ld 2>&1 | head -n 20
./executable -la 2>&1 | head -n 50
./executable -l 2>&1 | head -n 50
./executable -l 2>&1 | wc -l
./executable -lP 2>&1 | wc -l

for x in p P e u d o; do
  echo "=== -l${x} ==="
  ./executable -l${x} 2>&1 | head -n 30
done

# Test -v and -V
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc +a=6378137 -v 2>&1
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc +a=6378137 -V 2>&1
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -v 2>&1
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc +a=6378137 +b=6356752 -v 2>&1

# Test -b binary mode? Attempt
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -b 2>&1 | od -c | head

# -E
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -E 2>&1
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -E -f "%.2f" 2>&1

# -s and -t
printf "0 0\n1 1\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -s 2>&1
printf "0 0\n1 1\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -S 2>&1 || true

# Try -m
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -m 2 2>&1
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -m "1:1000" 2>&1 || true

# Try -r
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -r 2>&1

# Try -o
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -o 2>&1

# Try -d
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -d "   " 2>&1 || true
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -d "EE" 2>&1 || true
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -d 2>&1; echo $?

# -e
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -e "0.0" 2>&1 || true
# Look what proj manual says: -e string to separate? Let's search memory
# In PROJ, -e is to give alternative xy or something? Could be used to create an error file?

# -t
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -t a 2>&1
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -t "a" 2>&1
printf "1 2\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -t "1" 2>&1

# -w
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -w 2 2>&1
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -w2 2>&1
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -W2 2>&1
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -W 2 2>&1
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -w10 -f "%.2f" 2>&1

# -f format string
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -f "%.2f" 2>&1
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -f "%6.2f" 2>&1
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -f "%.2f" -E 2>&1

# test -I and -i with known inverse
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -I -f "%.6f" 2>&1
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -i -f "%.6f" 2>&1
# Check forward vs reverse
echo "Converting merc then inverse should return original"
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=merc -f "%.2f" 2>&1 > /tmp/forward.txt
cat /tmp/forward.txt
cat /tmp/forward.txt | ./executable +proj=merc -I -f "%.6f" 2>&1

# test file input
printf "0 0\n10 10\n" > /tmp/in.txt
./executable +proj=merc /tmp/in.txt 2>&1
./executable +proj=merc -E /tmp/in.txt 2>&1

# error handling
printf "not numbers\n" | ./executable +proj=merc 2>&1
echo EXIT:${PIPESTATUS[1]}
printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=unknown 2>&1
"}

      echo "OTHER -l$c rc $rc out: $out"

out,err,rc=bash_run('./executable +proj=merc -E -o <<< "0 0" 2>&1 | od -An -t x1')

print("-v -o", out, err)

# Test -v with -b?

print("-v -b", out, err)

# PROJ

PROJ is a generic coordinate transformation software that transforms
coordinates from one coordinate reference system (CRS) to another.
This includes cartographic projections as well as geodetic transformations.

## What PROJ Does

PROJ transforms geospatial coordinates between different coordinate reference systems.
It handles:
- Cartographic projections
- Geodetic transformations
- Datum conversions
- Coordinate system transformations

## Command Line Utilities

The PROJ package includes the following command-line utilities:

- **proj**: Cartographic projection of geodetic coordinates
- **cs2cs**: Transformation from one CRS to another CRS
- **geod**: Geodesic (great circle) computations
- **cct**: Generic Coordinate Conversions and Transformations
- **gie**: Geospatial Integrity Investigation Environment
- **projinfo**: Geodetic object and coordinate operation queries
- **projsync**: Synchronizing PROJ datum and transformation support data

## More Information

For more information about PROJ, visit:
- Website: <https://proj.org/>
- Mailing list: <https://lists.osgeo.org/mailman/listinfo/proj/>

## License

See the COPYING file for license information.

## Citation

See the CITATION file for how to cite PROJ in publications.

#!/bin/bash
# Test all projections from -lp list
./executable -lp 2>&1 | cut -d: -f1 | while read proj; do
  proj=$(echo $proj | xargs)
  # skip empty
  [ -z "$proj" ] && continue
  # try forward
  out=$(printf "0 0\n" | ./executable +proj=$proj -f "%.2f" 2>&1)
  rc=$?
  # capture first line of stderr? Actually we need to differentiate
  # If out contains "can't initialize", etc
  if echo "$out" | grep -q "can't initialize operations that produce angular"; then
    echo "FWD_ANGULAR $proj"
  elif echo "$out" | grep -q "can't initialize operations that take non-angular"; then
    echo "FWD_NONANGULAR $proj"
  elif echo "$out" | grep -q "projection initialization failure"; then
    echo "FWD_INITFAIL $proj: $(echo "$out" | head -n1)"
  elif echo "$out" | grep -q "CRS must be projected"; then
    echo "FWD_CRS_PROJ $proj"
  else
    echo "FWD_OK $proj -> $out"
  fi
done | head -n 300
EOS
chmod +x /tmp/test_proj_list.sh
/tmp/test_proj_list.sh 2>&1 | head -n 500
"}

        for line in LE_LIST.splitlines():

            parts = line.split()

            name = parts[0]

                ma = re.search(r'a=([0-9.]+)', line)
                if ma:
                    a = float(ma.group(1))
                mrf = re.search(r'rf=([0-9.]+)', line)
                mb = re.search(r'b=([0-9.]+)', line)
                if mrf:
                    rf = float(mrf.group(1))
                    f = 1/rf if rf!=0 else None
                if mb:
                    b = float(mb.group(1))
                break

    if b is None and f is None:

def merc_inverse(x, y, a=6378137.0, b=None, f=None, lat_ts=None, k0=1.0):
    if b is None and f is None:
        f = 1/298.257222101
        b = a*(1-f)
    if b is not None:
        if abs(b - a) < 1e-6:
            e = 0
            e2=0
        else:
            e2 = 1 - (b*b)/(a*a)
            e = math.sqrt(e2)
    elif f is not None:
        e2 = 2*f - f*f
        e = math.sqrt(e2)
    else:
        e=0

    if lat_ts is not None:
        lat_ts_rad = math.radians(lat_ts)
        if e==0:
            k0_ts = math.cos(lat_ts_rad)
        else:
            k0_ts = math.cos(lat_ts_rad)/math.sqrt(1 - e2*math.sin(lat_ts_rad)**2)
        k0 = k0_ts

    lon_rad = x / (a*k0)
    lon_deg = math.degrees(lon_rad)

    # Inverse lat
    # For spherical: lat = 2*atan(exp(y/(a*k0))) - pi/2
    # For ellipsoidal: iterative

    if e==0:
        lat_rad = 2*math.atan(math.exp(y/(a*k0))) - math.pi/2
        lat_deg = math.degrees(lat_rad)
    else:
        # iterative
        # First approximation spherical
        # t = exp(-y/(a*k0))
        # chi = pi/2 - 2*atan(t)
        # Then iterate lat = chi + e*...
        # Use method: 
        # lat = ... use formula from Snyder: lat = pi/2 - 2*atan( t * ((1 - e sin)/(1+e sin))^(e/2) ) iterated

        # Let's implement iteration:
        # t = exp(-y/(a*k0))
        # Start with lat = pi/2 -2*atan(t)
        # Iterate:

        t = math.exp(-y/(a*k0))
        # Actually for forward we had y = a*k0*(log(tan(...))+e/2 log(...))
        # So inverse: we need to solve.

        # Use iterative method:
        lat_rad = math.pi/2 - 2*math.atan(t)
        for _ in range(20):
            sin_lat = math.sin(lat_rad)
            # Compute new lat
            # e sin
            # Factor = ((1 - e sin)/(1+ e sin))^(e/2)
            # lat = pi/2 - 2*atan(t * factor)
            factor = ((1 - e*sin_lat)/(1+ e*sin_lat))**(e/2)
            lat_rad_new = math.pi/2 - 2*math.atan(t * factor)
            if abs(lat_rad_new - lat_rad) < 1e-12:
                lat_rad = lat_rad_new
                break
            lat_rad = lat_rad_new
        lat_deg = math.degrees(lat_rad)

    return lon_deg, lat_deg

                    sys.stdout.write(f"Meridian/Parallel angle: 90.00000\n")
                    sys.stdout.write(f"Convergence : 0d [ -0.00000000 ]\n")
                    sys.stdout.write(f"Max-min (Tissot axis a-b) scale error: 1.00000 1.00000\n")
                    sys.stdout.write("\n")

                # After V block, also need to output the transformed coordinates? In original -V, after block, it also output the transformed coordinates? Actually earlier for merc -V, after block it had blank line then next block? For single point, it had block then blank line. It did NOT output extra "0.00\t0.00" after block? Let's check: In earlier output for merc -V single point:

                # #Mercator
                # ...
                # Longitude: 0dE [ 0 ]
                # Latitude:  0dN [ 0 ]
                # Easting (x):   0.00
                # Northing (y):  0.00
                # ... scales ...
                # blank line

                # For -v, it outputs "#Mercator..." then "0.00\t0.00" (the transformed line). So -v prints description plus transformed line. -V prints description plus detailed block per point, but not the simple transformed line.

                # So for -V, we should NOT output the normal line after block (skip).

                if binary_output:
                    sys.stdout.buffer.write(struct.pack('<dd', float('inf'), float('inf')))
                else:
                    if e_str is not None:
                        sys.stdout.write(f"{e_str}\n")
                    else:
                        if label:
                            sys.stdout.write(f"*\t* {label}\n")
                        else:
                            sys.stdout.write("*\t*\n")
                continue

            # Format x_out, y_out

            if f_fmt is not None:
                try:
                    xs = f_fmt % x_out
                    ys = f_fmt % y_out
                except:
                    xs = f"{x_out:.2f}"
                    ys = f"{y_out:.2f}"
                out_line = f"{xs}\t{ys}"
            elif d_prec is not None:
                fmt = f"%.{d_prec}f"
                xs = fmt % x_out
                ys = fmt % y_out
                out_line = f"{xs}\t{ys}"
            else:
                if inverse:
                    # DMS
                    if W_val is not None:
                        lon_s = format_dms_verbose(x_out, True, W_val)
                        lat_s = format_dms_verbose(y_out, False, W_val)
                        out_line = f"{lon_s}\t{lat_s}"
                    elif w_val is not None:
                        lon_s = format_dms_compact(x_out, True, w_val)
                        lat_s = format_dms_compact(y_out, False, w_val)
                        out_line = f"{lon_s}\t{lat_s}"
                    else:
                        lon_s = format_dms_compact(x_out, True, None)
                        lat_s = format_dms_compact(y_out, False, None)
                        out_line = f"{lon_s}\t{lat_s}"
                else:
                    out_line = f"{x_out:.2f}\t{y_out:.2f}"

            if flags['S'] and not is_error:
                try:
                    if proj_name=='merc':
                        lat_r = math.radians(lat)
                        cos_lat = math.cos(lat_r)
                        if abs(cos_lat)<1e-12:
                            k=float('inf')
                        else:
                            k=1/math.cos(lat_r)
                            a_tmp,b_tmp,f_tmp = get_ellipsoid_params(proj_dict)
                            if f_tmp is not None:
                                e2=2*f_tmp - f_tmp*f_tmp
                                k=k*math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_r)**2)
                        h=k
                        s=h*k
                        w=0
                        a_t=k
                        b_t=k
                        out_line += f"\t<{h:g} {k:g} {s:g} {w:g} {a_t:g} {b_t:g}>"
                    else:
                        out_line += "\t<1 1 1 0 1 1>"
                except:
                    out_line += "\t<1 1 1 0 1 1>"

            # Handle label

            if flags['E']:
                # Echo input numbers
                # orig_numbers_str is like "0 0" or "10 20"
                # If orig_numbers_str empty (parsing failed), echo whole orig_line?
                echo_part = orig_numbers_str if orig_numbers_str else orig_line
                # For output, need to include label? Original for "0 0 hello" with -E gave "0 0\t0.00\t0.00 hello"
                # So final = echo_part + "\t" + out_line + (f" {label}" if label and label not in out_line else "")
                # But out_line already may contain scaling and not label? For "0 0 hello" without -S, out_line = "0.00\t0.00"
                # Then final with -E = "0 0\t0.00\t0.00 hello"

                if label:
                    final = f"{echo_part}\t{out_line} {label}"
                else:
                    final = f"{echo_part}\t{out_line}"

                    final = f"{out_line} {label}"
                else:
                    final = out_line
                sys.stdout.write(final+"\n")

    def process_binary_stream(stream):
        # Read all bytes
        data = stream.read() if hasattr(stream, 'read') else stream.buffer.read()
        # If stream is sys.stdin, need buffer
        # For binary input, we have pairs of doubles
        # Use little-endian '<d'?
        # Original uses native, but little-endian on x86_64 matches '<d'

        # We'll iterate over 16-byte chunks
        offset=0
        while offset+16 <= len(data):
            chunk = data[offset:offset+16]
            offset+=16
            try:
                lon_rad, lat_rad = struct.unpack('<dd', chunk)
            except:
                lon_rad, lat_rad = struct.unpack('dd', chunk)
            # lon_rad, lat_rad are in radians for forward, or x,y for inverse?

            # Apply -r
            if flags['r']:
                lon_rad, lat_rad = lat_rad, lon_rad

            # Apply -m
            if flags['m'] is not None:
                if not inverse:
                    lon_rad = lon_rad * m_factor
                    lat_rad = lat_rad * m_factor
                else:
                    lon_rad = lon_rad / m_factor if m_factor!=0 else lon_rad
                    lat_rad = lat_rad / m_factor if m_factor!=0 else lat_rad

            is_error=False
            try:
                if not inverse:
                    # forward: lon_rad, lat_rad are rad lon lat
                    lon_deg = math.degrees(lon_rad)
                    lat_deg = math.degrees(lat_rad)
                    if proj_name=='merc' and abs(lat_deg)>90:
                        raise ValueError("Invalid lat")
                    x_out,y_out = transform_forward(lon_deg, lat_deg, proj_name, proj_dict)
                else:
                    # inverse: lon_rad, lat_rad are actually x,y
                    x_in = lon_rad
                    y_in = lat_rad
                    x_out,y_out = transform_inverse(x_in, y_in, proj_name, proj_dict)
                    # Convert output lon lat to rad for binary output
                    x_out = math.radians(x_out)
                    y_out = math.radians(y_out)

                if math.isinf(x_out) or math.isinf(y_out):
                    is_error=True
            except:
                is_error=True
                sys.stderr.write(f"{proj_name}: Invalid latitude\n")

                x_out, y_out = y_out, x_out

            if is_error:
                # binary error output inf
                sys.stdout.buffer.write(struct.pack('<dd', float('inf'), float('inf')))
            else:
                if binary_output:
                    sys.stdout.buffer.write(struct.pack('<dd', x_out, y_out))
                else:
                    # ascii output from binary input (-i)
                    # Format
                    if f_fmt is not None:
                        xs = f_fmt % x_out
                        ys = f_fmt % y_out
                        sys.stdout.write(f"{xs}\t{ys}\n")
                    elif d_prec is not None:
                        fmt = f"%.{d_prec}f"
                        sys.stdout.write(f"{fmt % x_out}\t{fmt % y_out}\n")
                    else:
                        if inverse:
                            # DMS?
                            if W_val is not None:
                                lon_s = format_dms_verbose(math.degrees(x_out), True, W_val)
                                lat_s = format_dms_verbose(math.degrees(y_out), False, W_val)
                                sys.stdout.write(f"{lon_s}\t{lat_s}\n")
                            elif w_val is not None:
                                lon_s = format_dms_compact(math.degrees(x_out), True, w_val)
                                lat_s = format_dms_compact(math.degrees(y_out), False, w_val)
                                sys.stdout.write(f"{lon_s}\t{lat_s}\n")
                            else:
                                # default DMS
                                lon_s = format_dms_compact(math.degrees(x_out), True, None)
                                lat_s = format_dms_compact(math.degrees(y_out), False, None)
                                sys.stdout.write(f"{lon_s}\t{lat_s}\n")
                        else:
                            sys.stdout.write(f"{x_out:.2f}\t{y_out:.2f}\n")

    if binary_input:
        # For binary, we need to read from stdin.buffer (or file in binary)
        # If files present, need to read them as binary
        if not files:
            process_binary_stream(sys.stdin.buffer)
        else:
            for fname in files:
                if fname == '-':
                    process_binary_stream(sys.stdin.buffer)
                else:
                    try:
                        with open(fname, 'rb') as f:
                            process_binary_stream(f)
                    except FileNotFoundError:
                        error_sys_file(fname)
    else:
        # ascii
        if not files:
            process_ascii_stream(sys.stdin)
        else:
            for fname in files:
                if fname == '-':
                    process_ascii_stream(sys.stdin)
                else:
                    if not os.path.exists(fname):
                        error_sys_file(fname)
                    with open(fname, 'r') as f:
                        process_ascii_stream(f)

def is_valid_format(fmt):
    if fmt.count('%') != 1:
        return False
    if not fmt.startswith('%'):
        return False
    if fmt[-1] not in 'fFeEgG':
        return False
    middle = fmt[1:-1]
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[-+ #0-9.]*', middle):
        return False
    return True

def parse_dms(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        raise ValueError("empty")
    direction=None
    if s and s[-1].upper() in 'NSEW':
        direction=s[-1].upper()
        s=s[:-1].strip()
    pat = r'^\s*([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d*)?)\s*(?:[dD°]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d*)?)?\s*(?:[\'’]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d*)?)?\s*(?:["”])?)?)?\s*$'
    m=re.match(pat,s)
    if m:
        deg=float(m.group(1)) if m.group(1) else 0
        min_v=float(m.group(2)) if m.group(2) else 0
        sec_v=float(m.group(3)) if m.group(3) else 0
        dec=abs(deg)+min_v/60+sec_v/3600
        if deg<0:
            dec=-dec
    else:
        nums=re.findall(r'[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d*)?',s)
        if not nums:
            raise ValueError("cannot parse")
        deg=float(nums[0])
        min_v=float(nums[1]) if len(nums)>1 else 0
        sec_v=float(nums[2]) if len(nums)>2 else 0
        dec=abs(deg)+min_v/60+sec_v/3600
        if deg<0:
            dec=-dec
    if direction:
        if direction in 'SW':
            dec=-abs(dec)
        else:
            dec=abs(dec)
    return dec

def format_dms_compact(angle, is_lon, frac=None):
    if is_lon:
        pos='E'; neg='W'
    else:
        pos='N'; neg='S'
    dir_letter = pos if angle>=0 else neg
    abs_a = abs(angle)
    deg=int(abs_a)
    rem=(abs_a-deg)*60
    min_v=int(rem)
    sec=(rem-min_v)*60
    eps=1e-9
    if abs(sec)<eps:
        sec=0
    if sec==0 and min_v==0:
        return f"{deg}d{dir_letter}"
    if sec==0:
        return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{dir_letter}"
    if frac is None:
        sec_str=f"{sec:.3f}"
        if '.' in sec_str:
            sec_str=sec_str.rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
        return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"
    else:
        if frac==0:
            sec_i=int(round(sec))
            if sec_i>=60:
                sec_i=0
                min_v+=1
                if min_v>=60:
                    min_v=0
                    deg+=1
            return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_i}\"{dir_letter}"
        else:
            fmt=f"{{:.{frac}f}}"
            sec_str=fmt.format(sec)
            return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"

def format_dms_verbose(angle, is_lon, frac):
    if is_lon:
        pos='E'; neg='W'
    else:
        pos='N'; neg='S'
    dir_letter = pos if angle>=0 else neg
    abs_a=abs(angle)
    deg=int(abs_a)
    rem=(abs_a-deg)*60
    min_v=int(rem)
    sec=(rem-min_v)*60
    eps=1e-12
    if abs(sec)<eps:
        sec=0
    if frac==0:
        sec_i=int(round(sec))
        if sec_i>=60:
            sec_i=0
            min_v+=1
            if min_v>=60:
                min_v=0
                deg+=1
        return f"{deg}d{min_v:02d}'{sec_i:02d}\"{dir_letter}"
    else:
        sec_r=round(sec,frac)
        if sec_r>=60:
            sec_r=0
            min_v+=1
            if min_v>=60:
                min_v=0
                deg+=1
        width=2+1+frac
        fmt=f"{{:0{width}.{frac}f}}"
        sec_str=fmt.format(sec_r)
        return f"{deg}d{min_v:02d}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"

def get_ellipsoid(proj_dict):
    a=6378137.0
    b=None
    f=None
    if 'a' in proj_dict:
        try:
            a=float(proj_dict['a'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'R' in proj_dict:
        try:
            R=float(proj_dict['R'])
            a=R
            b=R
            return a,b,None
        except:
            pass
    if 'b' in proj_dict:
        try:
            b=float(proj_dict['b'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'rf' in proj_dict:
        try:
            rf=float(proj_dict['rf'])
            if rf!=0:
                f=1/rf
        except:
            pass
    if 'f' in proj_dict:
        try:
            f=float(proj_dict['f'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'ellps' in proj_dict:
        ellps=proj_dict['ellps']
        for line in LE_TXT.splitlines():
            parts=line.split()
            if not parts:
                continue
            name=parts[0]
            if name==ellps:
                ma=re.search(r'a=([0-9.]+)',line)
                if ma:
                    a=float(ma.group(1))
                mrf=re.search(r'rf=([0-9.]+)',line)
                mb=re.search(r'b=([0-9.]+)',line)
                if mrf:
                    rf=float(mrf.group(1))
                    f=1/rf if rf!=0 else None
                if mb:
                    b=float(mb.group(1))
                break
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    return a,b,f

def parse_proj_opts(opts):
    d={}
    for o in opts:
        if not o.startswith('+'):
            continue
        body=o[1:]
        if '=' in body:
            k,v=body.split('=',1)
            d[k]=v
        else:
            d[body]=True
    return d

def merc_fwd(lon_deg, lat_deg, a=6378137.0, b=None, f=None, lat_ts=None, k0=1.0):
    lon_rad=math.radians(lon_deg)
    lat_rad=math.radians(lat_deg)
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    if b is not None:
        if abs(b-a)<1e-6:
            e=0
            e2=0
        else:
            e2=1-(b*b)/(a*a)
            e=math.sqrt(e2)
    elif f is not None:
        e2=2*f-f*f
        e=math.sqrt(e2)
    else:
        e=0
        e2=0
    if lat_ts is not None:
        lat_ts_rad=math.radians(lat_ts)
        if e==0:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)
        else:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)/math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_ts_rad)**2)
        k0=k0_ts
    x=a*lon_rad*k0
    if e==0:
        y=a*k0*math.log(math.tan(math.pi/4+lat_rad/2))
    else:
        sin_lat=math.sin(lat_rad)
        if abs(lat_rad)>=math.pi/2-1e-12:
            y=float('inf') if lat_rad>0 else float('-inf')
        else:
            y=a*k0*(math.log(math.tan(math.pi/4+lat_rad/2)) + (e/2)*math.log((1-e*sin_lat)/(1+e*sin_lat)))
    return x,y

def merc_inv(x,y,a=6378137.0,b=None,f=None,lat_ts=None,k0=1.0):
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    if b is not None:
        if abs(b-a)<1e-6:
            e=0
            e2=0
        else:
            e2=1-(b*b)/(a*a)
            e=math.sqrt(e2)
    elif f is not None:
        e2=2*f-f*f
        e=math.sqrt(e2)
    else:
        e=0
        e2=0
    if lat_ts is not None:
        lat_ts_rad=math.radians(lat_ts)
        if e==0:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)
        else:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)/math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_ts_rad)**2)
        k0=k0_ts
    lon_rad=x/(a*k0)
    lon_deg=math.degrees(lon_rad)
    if e==0:
        lat_rad=2*math.atan(math.exp(y/(a*k0)))-math.pi/2
        lat_deg=math.degrees(lat_rad)
    else:
        t=math.exp(-y/(a*k0))
        lat_rad=math.pi/2-2*math.atan(t)
        for _ in range(20):
            sin_lat=math.sin(lat_rad)
            factor=((1-e*sin_lat)/(1+e*sin_lat))**(e/2)
            lat_new=math.pi/2-2*math.atan(t*factor)
            if abs(lat_new-lat_rad)<1e-12:
                lat_rad=lat_new
                break
            lat_rad=lat_new
        lat_deg=math.degrees(lat_rad)
    return lon_deg, lat_deg

def triv_fwd(lon,lat,a=6378137.0):
    return a*math.radians(lon), a*math.radians(lat)

def is_valid_format(fmt):
    if fmt.count('%') != 1:
        return False
    if not fmt.startswith('%'):
        return False
    if fmt[-1] not in 'fFeEgG':
        return False
    middle = fmt[1:-1]
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[-+ #0-9.]*', middle):
        return False
    return True

def parse_dms(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        raise ValueError("empty")
    direction=None
    if s and s[-1].upper() in 'NSEW':
        direction=s[-1].upper()
        s=s[:-1].strip()
    pat = r'^\s*([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d*)?)\s*(?:[dD°]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d*)?)?\s*(?:[\'’]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d*)?)?\s*(?:["”])?)?)?\s*$'
    m=re.match(pat,s)
    if m:
        deg=float(m.group(1)) if m.group(1) else 0
        min_v=float(m.group(2)) if m.group(2) else 0
        sec_v=float(m.group(3)) if m.group(3) else 0
        dec=abs(deg)+min_v/60+sec_v/3600
        if deg<0:
            dec=-dec
    else:
        nums=re.findall(r'[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d*)?',s)
        if not nums:
            raise ValueError("cannot parse")
        deg=float(nums[0])
        min_v=float(nums[1]) if len(nums)>1 else 0
        sec_v=float(nums[2]) if len(nums)>2 else 0
        dec=abs(deg)+min_v/60+sec_v/3600
        if deg<0:
            dec=-dec
    if direction:
        if direction in 'SW':
            dec=-abs(dec)
        else:
            dec=abs(dec)
    return dec

def format_dms_compact(angle, is_lon, frac=None):
    if is_lon:
        pos='E'; neg='W'
    else:
        pos='N'; neg='S'
    dir_letter = pos if angle>=0 else neg
    abs_a = abs(angle)
    deg=int(abs_a)
    rem=(abs_a-deg)*60
    min_v=int(rem)
    sec=(rem-min_v)*60
    eps=1e-9
    if abs(sec)<eps:
        sec=0
    if sec==0 and min_v==0:
        return f"{deg}d{dir_letter}"
    if sec==0:
        return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{dir_letter}"
    if frac is None:
        sec_str=f"{sec:.3f}"
        if '.' in sec_str:
            sec_str=sec_str.rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
        return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"
    else:
        if frac==0:
            sec_i=int(round(sec))
            if sec_i>=60:
                sec_i=0
                min_v+=1
                if min_v>=60:
                    min_v=0
                    deg+=1
            return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_i}\"{dir_letter}"
        else:
            fmt=f"{{:.{frac}f}}"
            sec_str=fmt.format(sec)
            return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"

def format_dms_verbose(angle, is_lon, frac):
    if is_lon:
        pos='E'; neg='W'

    dir_letter = pos if angle>=0 else neg

def get_ellipsoid(proj_dict):
    a=6378137.0
    b=None
    f=None
    if 'a' in proj_dict:
        try:
            a=float(proj_dict['a'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'R' in proj_dict:
        try:
            R=float(proj_dict['R'])
            a=R
            b=R
            return a,b,None
        except:
            pass
    if 'b' in proj_dict:
        try:
            b=float(proj_dict['b'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'rf' in proj_dict:
        try:
            rf=float(proj_dict['rf'])
            if rf!=0:
                f=1/rf
        except:
            pass
    if 'f' in proj_dict:
        try:
            f=float(proj_dict['f'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'ellps' in proj_dict:
        ellps=proj_dict['ellps']
        for line in LE_TXT.splitlines():
            parts=line.split()
            if not parts:
                continue
            name=parts[0]
            if name==ellps:
                ma=re.search(r'a=([0-9.]+)',line)
                if ma:
                    a=float(ma.group(1))
                mrf=re.search(r'rf=([0-9.]+)',line)
                mb=re.search(r'b=([0-9.]+)',line)
                if mrf:
                    rf=float(mrf.group(1))
                    f=1/rf if rf!=0 else None
                if mb:
                    b=float(mb.group(1))
                break
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    return a,b,f

def parse_proj_opts(opts):
    d={}
    for o in opts:
        if not o.startswith('+'):
            continue
        body=o[1:]
        if '=' in body:
            k,v=body.split('=',1)
            d[k]=v
        else:
            d[body]=True
    return d

def merc_fwd(lon_deg, lat_deg, a=6378137.0, b=None, f=None, lat_ts=None, k0=1.0):
    lon_rad=math.radians(lon_deg)
    lat_rad=math.radians(lat_deg)
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    if b is not None:
        if abs(b-a)<1e-6:
            e=0
            e2=0
        else:
            e2=1-(b*b)/(a*a)
            e=math.sqrt(e2)
    elif f is not None:
        e2=2*f-f*f
        e=math.sqrt(e2)
    else:
        e=0
        e2=0
    if lat_ts is not None:
        lat_ts_rad=math.radians(lat_ts)
        if e==0:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)
        else:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)/math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_ts_rad)**2)
        k0=k0_ts
    x=a*lon_rad*k0
    if e==0:
        y=a*k0*math.log(math.tan(math.pi/4+lat_rad/2))
    else:
        sin_lat=math.sin(lat_rad)
        if abs(lat_rad)>=math.pi/2-1e-12:
            y=float('inf') if lat_rad>0 else float('-inf')
        else:
            y=a*k0*(math.log(math.tan(math.pi/4+lat_rad/2)) + (e/2)*math.log((1-e*sin_lat)/(1+e*sin_lat)))
    return x,y

def merc_inv(x,y,a=6378137.0,b=None,f=None,lat_ts=None,k0=1.0):
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    if b is not None:
        if abs(b-a)<1e-6:
            e=0
            e2=0
        else:
            e2=1-(b*b)/(a*a)
            e=math.sqrt(e2)
    elif f is not None:
        e2=2*f-f*f
        e=math.sqrt(e2)
    else:
        e=0
        e2=0
    if lat_ts is not None:
        lat_ts_rad=math.radians(lat_ts)
        if e==0:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)
        else:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)/math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_ts_rad)**2)
        k0=k0_ts
    lon_rad=x/(a*k0)
    lon_deg=math.degrees(lon_rad)
    if e==0:
        lat_rad=2*math.atan(math.exp(y/(a*k0)))-math.pi/2
        lat_deg=math.degrees(lat_rad)
    else:
        t=math.exp(-y/(a*k0))
        lat_rad=math.pi/2-2*math.atan(t)
        for _ in range(20):
            sin_lat=math.sin(lat_rad)
            factor=((1-e*sin_lat)/(1+e*sin_lat))**(e/2)
            lat_new=math.pi/2-2*math.atan(t*factor)
            if abs(lat_new-lat_rad)<1e-12:
                lat_rad=lat_new
                break
            lat_rad=lat_new
        lat_deg=math.degrees(lat_rad)
    return lon_deg, lat_deg

def triv_fwd(lon,lat,a=6378137.0):
    return a*math.radians(lon), a*math.radians(lat)

def is_valid_format(fmt):
    if fmt.count('%') != 1:
        return False
    if not fmt.startswith('%'):
        return False
    if fmt[-1] not in 'fFeEgG':
        return False
    middle = fmt[1:-1]
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[-+ #0-9.]*', middle):
        return False
    return True

def parse_dms(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        raise ValueError("empty")
    direction=None
    if s and s[-1].upper() in 'NSEW':
        direction=s[-1].upper()
        s=s[:-1].strip()
    pat = r'^\s*([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d*)?)\s*(?:[dD°]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d*)?)?\s*(?:[\'’]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d*)?)?\s*(?:["”])?)?)?\s*$'
    m=re.match(pat,s)
    if m:
        deg=float(m.group(1)) if m.group(1) else 0
        min_v=float(m.group(2)) if m.group(2) else 0
        sec_v=float(m.group(3)) if m.group(3) else 0
        dec=abs(deg)+min_v/60+sec_v/3600
        if deg<0:
            dec=-dec
    else:
        nums=re.findall(r'[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d*)?',s)
        if not nums:
            raise ValueError("cannot parse")
        deg=float(nums[0])
        min_v=float(nums[1]) if len(nums)>1 else 0
        sec_v=float(nums[2]) if len(nums)>2 else 0
        dec=abs(deg)+min_v/60+sec_v/3600
        if deg<0:
            dec=-dec
    if direction:
        if direction in 'SW':
            dec=-abs(dec)
        else:
            dec=abs(dec)
    return dec

def format_dms_compact(angle, is_lon, frac=None):
    if is_lon:
        pos='E'; neg='W'
    else:
        pos='N'; neg='S'
    dir_letter = pos if angle>=0 else neg
    abs_a = abs(angle)
    deg=int(abs_a)
    rem=(abs_a-deg)*60
    min_v=int(rem)
    sec=(rem-min_v)*60
    eps=1e-9
    if abs(sec)<eps:
        sec=0
    if sec==0 and min_v==0:
        return f"{deg}d{dir_letter}"
    if sec==0:
        return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{dir_letter}"
    if frac is None:
        sec_str=f"{sec:.3f}"
        if '.' in sec_str:
            sec_str=sec_str.rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
        return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"
    else:
        if frac==0:
            sec_i=int(round(sec))
            if sec_i>=60:
                sec_i=0
                min_v+=1
                if min_v>=60:
                    min_v=0
                    deg+=1
            return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_i}\"{dir_letter}"
        else:
            fmt=f"{{:.{frac}f}}"
            sec_str=fmt.format(sec)
            return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"

def format_dms_verbose(angle, is_lon, frac):
    if is_lon:
        pos='E'; neg='W'
    else:
        pos='N'; neg='S'
    dir_letter = pos if angle>=0 else neg
    abs_a=abs(angle)
    deg=int(abs_a)
    rem=(abs_a-deg)*60
    min_v=int(rem)
    sec=(rem-min_v)*60
    eps=1e-12
    if abs(sec)<eps:
        sec=0
    if frac==0:
        sec_i=int(round(sec))
        if sec_i>=60:
            sec_i=0
            min_v+=1
            if min_v>=60:
                min_v=0
                deg+=1
        return f"{deg}d{min_v:02d}'{sec_i:02d}\"{dir_letter}"
    else:
        sec_r=round(sec,frac)
        if sec_r>=60:
            sec_r=0

        width=2+1+frac
        fmt=f"{{:0{width}.{frac}f}}"
        sec_str=fmt.format(sec_r)
        return f"{deg}d{min_v:02d}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"

def get_ellipsoid(proj_dict):
    a=6378137.0
    b=None
    f=None
    if 'a' in proj_dict:
        try:
            a=float(proj_dict['a'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'R' in proj_dict:
        try:
            R=float(proj_dict['R'])
            a=R
            b=R
            return a,b,None
        except:
            pass
    if 'b' in proj_dict:
        try:
            b=float(proj_dict['b'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'rf' in proj_dict:
        try:
            rf=float(proj_dict['rf'])
            if rf!=0:
                f=1/rf
        except:
            pass
    if 'f' in proj_dict:
        try:
            f=float(proj_dict['f'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'ellps' in proj_dict:
        ellps=proj_dict['ellps']
        for line in LE_TXT.splitlines():
            parts=line.split()
            if not parts:
                continue
            name=parts[0]
            if name==ellps:
                ma=re.search(r'a=([0-9.]+)',line)
                if ma:
                    a=float(ma.group(1))
                mrf=re.search(r'rf=([0-9.]+)',line)
                mb=re.search(r'b=([0-9.]+)',line)
                if mrf:
                    rf=float(mrf.group(1))
                    f=1/rf if rf!=0 else None
                if mb:
                    b=float(mb.group(1))
                break
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    return a,b,f

def parse_proj_opts(opts):
    d={}
    for o in opts:
        if not o.startswith('+'):
            continue
        body=o[1:]
        if '=' in body:
            k,v=body.split('=',1)
            d[k]=v
        else:
            d[body]=True
    return d

def merc_fwd(lon_deg, lat_deg, a=6378137.0, b=None, f=None, lat_ts=None, k0=1.0):
    lon_rad=math.radians(lon_deg)
    lat_rad=math.radians(lat_deg)
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    if b is not None:
        if abs(b-a)<1e-6:
            e=0
            e2=0
        else:
            e2=1-(b*b)/(a*a)
            e=math.sqrt(e2)
    elif f is not None:
        e2=2*f-f*f
        e=math.sqrt(e2)
    else:
        e=0
        e2=0
    if lat_ts is not None:
        lat_ts_rad=math.radians(lat_ts)
        if e==0:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)
        else:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)/math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_ts_rad)**2)
        k0=k0_ts
    x=a*lon_rad*k0
    if e==0:
        y=a*k0*math.log(math.tan(math.pi/4+lat_rad/2))
    else:
        sin_lat=math.sin(lat_rad)
        if abs(lat_rad)>=math.pi/2-1e-12:
            y=float('inf') if lat_rad>0 else float('-inf')
        else:
            y=a*k0*(math.log(math.tan(math.pi/4+lat_rad/2)) + (e/2)*math.log((1-e*sin_lat)/(1+e*sin_lat)))
    return x,y

def merc_inv(x,y,a=6378137.0,b=None,f=None,lat_ts=None,k0=1.0):
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    if b is not None:
        if abs(b-a)<1e-6:
            e=0
            e2=0
        else:
            e2=1-(b*b)/(a*a)
            e=math.sqrt(e2)
    elif f is not None:
        e2=2*f-f*f
        e=math.sqrt(e2)
    else:
        e=0
        e2=0
    if lat_ts is not None:
        lat_ts_rad=math.radians(lat_ts)
        if e==0:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)
        else:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)/math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_ts_rad)**2)
        k0=k0_ts
    lon_rad=x/(a*k0)
    lon_deg=math.degrees(lon_rad)
    if e==0:
        lat_rad=2*math.atan(math.exp(y/(a*k0)))-math.pi/2
        lat_deg=math.degrees(lat_rad)
    else:
        t=math.exp(-y/(a*k0))
        lat_rad=math.pi/2-2*math.atan(t)
        for _ in range(20):
            sin_lat=math.sin(lat_rad)
            factor=((1-e*sin_lat)/(1+e*sin_lat))**(e/2)
            lat_new=math.pi/2-2*math.atan(t*factor)
            if abs(lat_new-lat_rad)<1e-12:
                lat_rad=lat_new
                break
            lat_rad=lat_new
        lat_deg=math.degrees(lat_rad)
    return lon_deg, lat_deg

def is_valid_format(fmt):
    if fmt.count('%') != 1:
        return False
    if not fmt.startswith('%'):
        return False
    if fmt[-1] not in 'fFeEgG':
        return False
    middle = fmt[1:-1]
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[-+ #0-9.]*', middle):
        return False
    return True

def parse_dms(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        raise ValueError("empty")
    direction=None
    if s and s[-1].upper() in 'NSEW':
        direction=s[-1].upper()
        s=s[:-1].strip()
    pat = r'^\s*([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d*)?)\s*(?:[dD°]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d*)?)?\s*(?:[\'’]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d*)?)?\s*(?:["”])?)?)?\s*$'
    m=re.match(pat,s)
    if m:
        deg=float(m.group(1)) if m.group(1) else 0
        min_v=float(m.group(2)) if m.group(2) else 0
        sec_v=float(m.group(3)) if m.group(3) else 0
        dec=abs(deg)+min_v/60+sec_v/3600
        if deg<0:
            dec=-dec
    else:
        nums=re.findall(r'[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d*)?',s)
        if not nums:
            raise ValueError("cannot parse")
        deg=float(nums[0])
        min_v=float(nums[1]) if len(nums)>1 else 0
        sec_v=float(nums[2]) if len(nums)>2 else 0
        dec=abs(deg)+min_v/60+sec_v/3600
        if deg<0:
            dec=-dec
    if direction:
        if direction in 'SW':
            dec=-abs(dec)
        else:
            dec=abs(dec)
    return dec

def format_dms_compact(angle, is_lon, frac=None):
    if is_lon:
        pos='E'; neg='W'
    else:
        pos='N'; neg='S'
    dir_letter = pos if angle>=0 else neg
    abs_a = abs(angle)
    deg=int(abs_a)
    rem=(abs_a-deg)*60
    min_v=int(rem)
    sec=(rem-min_v)*60
    eps=1e-9
    if abs(sec)<eps:
        sec=0
    if sec==0 and min_v==0:
        return f"{deg}d{dir_letter}"
    if sec==0:
        return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{dir_letter}"
    if frac is None:
        sec_str=f"{sec:.3f}"
        if '.' in sec_str:
            sec_str=sec_str.rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
        return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"
    else:
        if frac==0:
            sec_i=int(round(sec))
            if sec_i>=60:
                sec_i=0
                min_v+=1
                if min_v>=60:
                    min_v=0
                    deg+=1
            return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_i}\"{dir_letter}"
        else:
            fmt=f"{{:.{frac}f}}"
            sec_str=fmt.format(sec)
            return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"

def format_dms_verbose(angle, is_lon, frac):
    if is_lon:
        pos='E'; neg='W'
    else:
        pos='N'; neg='S'
    dir_letter = pos if angle>=0 else neg
    abs_a=abs(angle)
    deg=int(abs_a)
    rem=(abs_a-deg)*60
    min_v=int(rem)
    sec=(rem-min_v)*60
    eps=1e-12
    if abs(sec)<eps:
        sec=0
    if frac==0:
        sec_i=int(round(sec))
        if sec_i>=60:
            sec_i=0
            min_v+=1
            if min_v>=60:
                min_v=0
                deg+=1
        return f"{deg}d{min_v:02d}'{sec_i:02d}\"{dir_letter}"
    else:
        sec_r=round(sec,frac)
        if sec_r>=60:
            sec_r=0
            min_v+=1
            if min_v>=60:
                min_v=0
                deg+=1
        width=2+1+frac
        fmt=f"{{:0{width}.{frac}f}}"
        sec_str=fmt.format(sec_r)
        return f"{deg}d{min_v:02d}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"

def get_ellipsoid(proj_dict):
    a=6378137.0
    b=None
    f=None
    if 'a' in proj_dict:
        try:
            a=float(proj_dict['a'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'R' in proj_dict:
        try:
            R=float(proj_dict['R'])
            a=R
            b=R
            return a,b,None
        except:
            pass
    if 'b' in proj_dict:
        try:
            b=float(proj_dict['b'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'rf' in proj_dict:
        try:
            rf=float(proj_dict['rf'])
            if rf!=0:
                f=1/rf
        except:
            pass
    if 'f' in proj_dict:
        try:
            f=float(proj_dict['f'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'ellps' in proj_dict:
        ellps=proj_dict['ellps']
        for line in LE_TXT.splitlines():
            parts=line.split()
            if not parts:
                continue
            name=parts[0]
            if name==ellps:
                ma=re.search(r'a=([0-9.]+)',line)
                if ma:
                    a=float(ma.group(1))
                mrf=re.search(r'rf=([0-9.]+)',line)
                mb=re.search(r'b=([0-9.]+)',line)
                if mrf:
                    rf=float(mrf.group(1))
                    f=1/rf if rf!=0 else None
                if mb:
                    b=float(mb.group(1))
                break
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    return a,b,f

def parse_proj_opts(opts):
    d={}
    for o in opts:
        if not o.startswith('+'):
            continue
        body=o[1:]
        if '=' in body:
            k,v=body.split('=',1)
            d[k]=v
        else:
            d[body]=True
    return d

def merc_fwd(lon_deg, lat_deg, a=6378137.0, b=None, f=None, lat_ts=None, k0=1.0):
    lon_rad=math.radians(lon_deg)
    lat_rad=math.radians(lat_deg)
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    if b is not None:
        if abs(b-a)<1e-6:
            e=0
            e2=0
        else:
            e2=1-(b*b)/(a*a)
            e=math.sqrt(e2)
    elif f is not None:
        e2=2*f-f*f
        e=math.sqrt(e2)
    else:
        e=0
        e2=0
    if lat_ts is not None:
        lat_ts_rad=math.radians(lat_ts)
        if e==0:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)
        else:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)/math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_ts_rad)**2)
        k0=k0_ts
    x=a*lon_rad*k0
    if e==0:
        y=a*k0*math.log(math.tan(math.pi/4+lat_rad/2))
    else:
        sin_lat=math.sin(lat_rad)
        if abs(lat_rad)>=math.pi/2-1e-12:
            y=float('inf') if lat_rad>0 else float('-inf')
        else:
            y=a*k0*(math.log(math.tan(math.pi/4+lat_rad/2)) + (e/2)*math.log((1-e*sin_lat)/(1+e*sin_lat)))
    return x,y

def merc_inv(x,y,a=6378137.0,b=None,f=None,lat_ts=None,k0=1.0):
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    if b is not None:
        if abs(b-a)<1e-6:
            e=0
            e2=0
        else:
            e2=1-(b*b)/(a*a)
            e=math.sqrt(e2)
    elif f is not None:
        e2=2*f-f*f
        e=math.sqrt(e2)
    else:
        e=0
        e2=0
    if lat_ts is not None:
        lat_ts_rad=math.radians(lat_ts)
        if e==0:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)
        else:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)/math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_ts_rad)**2)
        k0=k0_ts
    lon_rad=x/(a*k0)
    lon_deg=math.degrees(lon_rad)
    if e==0:
        lat_rad=2*math.atan(math.exp(y/(a*k0)))-math.pi/2
        lat_deg=math.degrees(lat_rad)
    else:
        t=math.exp(-y/(a*k0))
        lat_rad=math.pi/2-2*math.atan(t)
        for _ in range(20):
            sin_lat=math.sin(lat_rad)
            factor=((1-e*sin_lat)/(1+e*sin_lat))**(e/2)
            lat_new=math.pi/2-2*math.atan(t*factor)
            if abs(lat_new-lat_rad)<1e-12:
                lat_rad=lat_new
                break
            lat_rad=lat_new
        lat_deg=math.degrees(lat_rad)
    return lon_deg, lat_deg

def is_valid_format(fmt):
    if fmt.count('%') != 1:
        return False
    if not fmt.startswith('%'):
        return False
    if fmt[-1] not in 'fFeEgG':
        return False
    middle = fmt[1:-1]
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[-+ #0-9.]*', middle):
        return False
    return True

def fmt_float(val, fmt_str):
    try:
        if val == 0.0:
            val = 0.0
        if isinstance(val, float) and abs(val) < 5e-9:
            val = 0.0
        s = fmt_str % val
        try:
            if s.lstrip().startswith('-'):
                stripped = s.strip()
                try:
                    if float(stripped) == 0.0:
                        m=re.search(r'%[-+ #0]*([0-9]+)', fmt_str)
                        if m:
                            s = ' ' + s[1:]
                        else:
                            s = s[1:]
                except:
                    pass
        except:
            pass
        return s
    except:
        return str(val)

def parse_dms(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        raise ValueError("empty")
    direction=None
    if s and s[-1].upper() in 'NSEW':
        direction=s[-1].upper()
        s=s[:-1].strip()
    pat = r'^\s*([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d*)?)\s*(?:[dD°]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d*)?)?\s*(?:[\'’]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d*)?)?\s*(?:["”])?)?)?\s*$'
    m=re.match(pat,s)
    if m:
        deg=float(m.group(1)) if m.group(1) else 0
        min_v=float(m.group(2)) if m.group(2) else 0
        sec_v=float(m.group(3)) if m.group(3) else 0
        dec=abs(deg)+min_v/60+sec_v/3600
        if deg<0:
            dec=-dec
    else:
        nums=re.findall(r'[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d*)?',s)
        if not nums:
            raise ValueError("cannot parse")
        deg=float(nums[0])
        min_v=float(nums[1]) if len(nums)>1 else 0
        sec_v=float(nums[2]) if len(nums)>2 else 0
        dec=abs(deg)+min_v/60+sec_v/3600
        if deg<0:
            dec=-dec
    if direction:
        if direction in 'SW':
            dec=-abs(dec)
        else:
            dec=abs(dec)
    return dec

def format_dms_compact(angle, is_lon, frac=None):
    if is_lon:
        pos='E'; neg='W'
    else:
        pos='N'; neg='S'
    dir_letter = pos if angle>=0 else neg
    abs_a = abs(angle)
    if abs(abs_a - round(abs_a)) < 1e-8:
        abs_a = round(abs_a)
    deg=int(abs_a)
    rem=(abs_a-deg)*60
    if abs(rem-60) < 1e-8:
        rem=0
        deg+=1
    if abs(rem) < 1e-8:
        rem=0
    min_v=int(rem)
    sec=(rem-min_v)*60
    if abs(sec-60) < 1e-7:
        sec=0
        min_v+=1
        if min_v>=60:
            min_v=0
            deg+=1
    eps=1e-9
    if abs(sec)<eps:
        sec=0
    if frac is None:
        sec_r=round(sec,3)
        if sec_r>=60:
            sec_r=0
            min_v+=1
            if min_v>=60:
                min_v=0
                deg+=1
            sec=sec_r
        elif abs(sec_r)<eps:
            sec=0
    else:
        if frac==0:
            sec_r=int(round(sec))
            if sec_r>=60:
                sec_r=0
                min_v+=1
                if min_v>=60:
                    min_v=0
                    deg+=1
                sec=sec_r
        else:
            sec_r=round(sec, frac)
            if sec_r>=60:
                sec_r=0
                min_v+=1
                if min_v>=60:
                    min_v=0
                    deg+=1
                sec=sec_r
            elif abs(sec_r)< (0.5*10**(-frac)):
                if abs(sec)<0.5*10**(-frac):
                    sec=0
    if sec==0 and min_v==0:
        return f"{deg}d{dir_letter}"
    if sec==0:
        return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{dir_letter}"
    if frac is None:
        sec_str=f"{sec:.3f}"
        if '.' in sec_str:
            sec_str=sec_str.rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
        return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"
    else:
        if frac==0:
            sec_i=int(sec) if isinstance(sec, int) or sec==int(sec) else int(round(sec))
            return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_i}\"{dir_letter}"
        else:
            fmt=f"{{:.{frac}f}}"
            sec_str=fmt.format(sec)
            return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"

def format_dms_verbose(angle, is_lon, frac):
    if is_lon:

    eps=1e-12
    if abs(sec)<eps:

    if frac==0:
        sec_i=int(round(sec))

            min_v+=1

        return f"{deg}d{min_v:02d}'{sec_i:02d}\"{dir_letter}"

def get_ellipsoid(proj_dict):
    a=6378137.0
    b=None
    f=None
    if 'a' in proj_dict:
        try:
            a=float(proj_dict['a'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'R' in proj_dict:
        try:
            R=float(proj_dict['R'])
            a=R
            b=R
            return a,b,None
        except:
            pass
    if 'b' in proj_dict:
        try:
            b=float(proj_dict['b'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'rf' in proj_dict:
        try:
            rf=float(proj_dict['rf'])
            if rf!=0:
                f=1/rf
        except:
            pass
    if 'f' in proj_dict:
        try:
            f=float(proj_dict['f'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'ellps' in proj_dict:
        ellps=proj_dict['ellps']
        for line in LE_TXT.splitlines():
            parts=line.split()
            if not parts:
                continue
            name=parts[0]
            if name==ellps:
                ma=re.search(r'a=([0-9.]+)',line)
                if ma:
                    a=float(ma.group(1))
                mrf=re.search(r'rf=([0-9.]+)',line)
                mb=re.search(r'b=([0-9.]+)',line)
                if mrf:
                    rf=float(mrf.group(1))
                    f=1/rf if rf!=0 else None
                if mb:
                    b=float(mb.group(1))
                break
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    return a,b,f

def parse_proj_opts(opts):
    d={}
    for o in opts:
        if not o.startswith('+'):
            continue
        body=o[1:]
        if '=' in body:
            k,v=body.split('=',1)
            d[k]=v
        else:
            d[body]=True
    return d

def merc_fwd(lon_deg, lat_deg, a=6378137.0, b=None, f=None, lat_ts=None, k0=1.0):
    lon_rad=math.radians(lon_deg)
    lat_rad=math.radians(lat_deg)
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    if b is not None:
        if abs(b-a)<1e-6:
            e=0
            e2=0
        else:
            e2=1-(b*b)/(a*a)
            e=math.sqrt(e2)
    elif f is not None:
        e2=2*f-f*f
        e=math.sqrt(e2)
    else:
        e=0
        e2=0
    if lat_ts is not None:
        lat_ts_rad=math.radians(lat_ts)
        if e==0:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)
        else:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)/math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_ts_rad)**2)
        k0=k0_ts
    x=a*lon_rad*k0
    if e==0:
        y=a*k0*math.log(math.tan(math.pi/4+lat_rad/2))
    else:
        sin_lat=math.sin(lat_rad)
        if abs(lat_rad)>=math.pi/2-1e-12:
            y=float('inf') if lat_rad>0 else float('-inf')
        else:
            y=a*k0*(math.log(math.tan(math.pi/4+lat_rad/2)) + (e/2)*math.log((1-e*sin_lat)/(1+e*sin_lat)))
    return x,y

def merc_inv(x,y,a=6378137.0,b=None,f=None,lat_ts=None,k0=1.0):
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    if b is not None:
        if abs(b-a)<1e-6:
            e=0
            e2=0
        else:
            e2=1-(b*b)/(a*a)
            e=math.sqrt(e2)
    elif f is not None:
        e2=2*f-f*f
        e=math.sqrt(e2)
    else:
        e=0
        e2=0
    if lat_ts is not None:
        lat_ts_rad=math.radians(lat_ts)
        if e==0:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)
        else:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)/math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_ts_rad)**2)
        k0=k0_ts
    lon_rad=x/(a*k0)
    lon_deg=math.degrees(lon_rad)
    if e==0:
        lat_rad=2*math.atan(math.exp(y/(a*k0)))-math.pi/2
        lat_deg=math.degrees(lat_rad)
    else:
        t=math.exp(-y/(a*k0))
        lat_rad=math.pi/2-2*math.atan(t)
        for _ in range(20):
            sin_lat=math.sin(lat_rad)
            factor=((1-e*sin_lat)/(1+e*sin_lat))**(e/2)
            lat_new=math.pi/2-2*math.atan(t*factor)
            if abs(lat_new-lat_rad)<1e-12:
                lat_rad=lat_new
                break
            lat_rad=lat_new
        lat_deg=math.degrees(lat_rad)
    return lon_deg, lat_deg

    def get_v_desc():
        lines=LP_EXP.splitlines()

                des=[]
                parts=l.split(':',1)
                if len(parts)==2:
                    des.append(f"#{parts[1].strip()}")
                j=idx+1
                while j < len(lines) and lines[j].startswith('\t'):
                    des.append(f"#{lines[j]}")
                    j+=1
                proj_str_parts=proj_opts[:]
                if not any('break_cs2cs_recursion' in p for p in proj_str_parts):
                    proj_str_parts.append('+break_cs2cs_recursion')
                has_ellps=any('ellps' in p or 'a=' in p or 'b=' in p or 'R=' in p for p in proj_str_parts)
                if not has_ellps:
                    proj_str_parts.append('+ellps=GRS80')
                des.append("# "+" ".join(proj_str_parts))
                return "\n".join(des)+"\n"
        return f"#{proj_name}\n# +proj={proj_name}\n"

    def parse_ascii_line(line):
        orig=line.rstrip('\n')
        if orig.strip().startswith('#'):
            return ('comment', orig)
        if not orig.strip():
            return ('coords', 0.0, 0.0, "", "", orig)
        tokens=orig.strip().split()
        if len(tokens)>=2:
            try:
                lon=parse_dms(tokens[0])
                lat=parse_dms(tokens[1])
                orig_num=f"{tokens[0]} {tokens[1]}"
                label=" ".join(tokens[2:]) if len(tokens)>2 else ""
                return ('coords', lon, lat, label, orig_num, orig)
            except:
                return ('coords', 0.0, 0.0, orig.strip(), "", orig)
        else:
            return ('coords', 0.0, 0.0, orig.strip(), "", orig)

def is_valid_format(fmt):
    if fmt.count('%') != 1:
        return False
    if not fmt.startswith('%'):
        return False
    if fmt[-1] not in 'fFeEgG':
        return False
    middle = fmt[1:-1]
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[-+ #0-9.]*', middle):
        return False
    return True

def fmt_float(val, fmt_str):
    try:
        if val == 0.0:
            val = 0.0
        if isinstance(val, float) and abs(val) < 5e-9:
            val = 0.0
        s = fmt_str % val
        try:
            if s.lstrip().startswith('-'):
                stripped = s.strip()
                try:
                    if float(stripped) == 0.0:
                        m=re.search(r'%[-+ #0]*([0-9]+)', fmt_str)
                        if m:
                            s = ' ' + s[1:]
                        else:
                            s = s[1:]
                except:
                    pass
        except:
            pass
        return s
    except:
        return str(val)

def parse_dms(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        raise ValueError("empty")
    direction=None
    if s and s[-1].upper() in 'NSEW':
        direction=s[-1].upper()
        s=s[:-1].strip()
    pat = r'^\s*([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d*)?)\s*(?:[dD°]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d*)?)?\s*(?:[\'’]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d*)?)?\s*(?:["”])?)?)?\s*$'
    m=re.match(pat,s)
    if m:
        deg=float(m.group(1)) if m.group(1) else 0
        min_v=float(m.group(2)) if m.group(2) else 0
        sec_v=float(m.group(3)) if m.group(3) else 0
        dec=abs(deg)+min_v/60+sec_v/3600
        if deg<0:
            dec=-dec
    else:
        nums=re.findall(r'[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d*)?',s)
        if not nums:
            raise ValueError("cannot parse")
        deg=float(nums[0])
        min_v=float(nums[1]) if len(nums)>1 else 0
        sec_v=float(nums[2]) if len(nums)>2 else 0
        dec=abs(deg)+min_v/60+sec_v/3600
        if deg<0:
            dec=-dec
    if direction:
        if direction in 'SW':
            dec=-abs(dec)
        else:
            dec=abs(dec)
    return dec

def format_dms_compact(angle, is_lon, frac=None):
    if is_lon:
        pos='E'; neg='W'
    else:
        pos='N'; neg='S'
    dir_letter = pos if angle>=0 else neg
    abs_a = abs(angle)
    if abs(abs_a - round(abs_a)) < 1e-8:
        abs_a = round(abs_a)
    deg=int(abs_a)
    rem=(abs_a-deg)*60
    if abs(rem-60) < 1e-8:
        rem=0
        deg+=1
    if abs(rem) < 1e-8:
        rem=0
    min_v=int(rem)
    sec=(rem-min_v)*60
    if abs(sec-60) < 1e-7:
        sec=0
        min_v+=1
        if min_v>=60:
            min_v=0
            deg+=1
    eps=1e-9
    if abs(sec)<eps:
        sec=0
    if frac is None:
        sec_r=round(sec,3)
        if sec_r>=60:
            sec_r=0
            min_v+=1
            if min_v>=60:
                min_v=0
                deg+=1
            sec=sec_r
        elif abs(sec_r)<eps:
            sec=0
    else:
        if frac==0:
            sec_r=int(round(sec))
            if sec_r>=60:
                sec_r=0
                min_v+=1
                if min_v>=60:
                    min_v=0
                    deg+=1
                sec=sec_r
        else:
            sec_r=round(sec, frac)
            if sec_r>=60:
                sec_r=0
                min_v+=1
                if min_v>=60:
                    min_v=0
                    deg+=1
                sec=sec_r
            elif abs(sec_r)< (0.5*10**(-frac)):
                if abs(sec)<0.5*10**(-frac):
                    sec=0
    if sec==0 and min_v==0:
        return f"{deg}d{dir_letter}"
    if sec==0:
        return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{dir_letter}"
    if frac is None:
        sec_str=f"{sec:.3f}"
        if '.' in sec_str:
            sec_str=sec_str.rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
        return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"
    else:
        if frac==0:
            sec_i=int(sec) if isinstance(sec, int) or sec==int(sec) else int(round(sec))
            return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_i}\"{dir_letter}"
        else:
            fmt=f"{{:.{frac}f}}"
            sec_str=fmt.format(sec)
            return f"{deg}d{min_v}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"

def format_dms_verbose(angle, is_lon, frac):
    if is_lon:
        pos='E'; neg='W'
    else:
        pos='N'; neg='S'
    dir_letter = pos if angle>=0 else neg
    abs_a=abs(angle)
    deg=int(abs_a)
    rem=(abs_a-deg)*60
    min_v=int(rem)
    sec=(rem-min_v)*60
    eps=1e-12
    if abs(sec)<eps:
        sec=0
    if frac==0:
        sec_i=int(round(sec))
        if sec_i>=60:
            sec_i=0
            min_v+=1
            if min_v>=60:
                min_v=0
                deg+=1
        return f"{deg}d{min_v:02d}'{sec_i:02d}\"{dir_letter}"
    else:
        sec_r=round(sec,frac)
        if sec_r>=60:
            sec_r=0
            min_v+=1
            if min_v>=60:
                min_v=0
                deg+=1
        width=2+1+frac
        fmt=f"{{:0{width}.{frac}f}}"
        sec_str=fmt.format(sec_r)
        return f"{deg}d{min_v:02d}'{sec_str}\"{dir_letter}"

def get_ellipsoid(proj_dict):
    a=6378137.0
    b=None
    f=None
    if 'a' in proj_dict:
        try:
            a=float(proj_dict['a'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'R' in proj_dict:
        try:
            R=float(proj_dict['R'])
            a=R
            b=R
            return a,b,None
        except:
            pass
    if 'b' in proj_dict:
        try:
            b=float(proj_dict['b'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'rf' in proj_dict:
        try:
            rf=float(proj_dict['rf'])
            if rf!=0:
                f=1/rf
        except:
            pass
    if 'f' in proj_dict:
        try:
            f=float(proj_dict['f'])
        except:
            pass
    if 'ellps' in proj_dict:
        ellps=proj_dict['ellps']
        for line in LE_TXT.splitlines():
            parts=line.split()
            if not parts:
                continue
            name=parts[0]
            if name==ellps:
                ma=re.search(r'a=([0-9.]+)',line)
                if ma:
                    a=float(ma.group(1))
                mrf=re.search(r'rf=([0-9.]+)',line)
                mb=re.search(r'b=([0-9.]+)',line)
                if mrf:
                    rf=float(mrf.group(1))
                    f=1/rf if rf!=0 else None
                if mb:
                    b=float(mb.group(1))
                break
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    return a,b,f

def parse_proj_opts(opts):

        body=o[1:]

    return d

def merc_fwd(lon_deg, lat_deg, a=6378137.0, b=None, f=None, lat_ts=None, k0=1.0):
    lon_rad=math.radians(lon_deg)
    lat_rad=math.radians(lat_deg)
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    if b is not None:
        if abs(b-a)<1e-6:
            e=0
            e2=0
        else:
            e2=1-(b*b)/(a*a)
            e=math.sqrt(e2)
    elif f is not None:
        e2=2*f-f*f
        e=math.sqrt(e2)
    else:
        e=0
        e2=0
    if lat_ts is not None:
        lat_ts_rad=math.radians(lat_ts)
        if e==0:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)
        else:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)/math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_ts_rad)**2)
        k0=k0_ts
    x=a*lon_rad*k0
    if e==0:
        y=a*k0*math.log(math.tan(math.pi/4+lat_rad/2))
    else:
        sin_lat=math.sin(lat_rad)
        if abs(lat_rad)>=math.pi/2-1e-12:
            y=float('inf') if lat_rad>0 else float('-inf')
        else:
            y=a*k0*(math.log(math.tan(math.pi/4+lat_rad/2)) + (e/2)*math.log((1-e*sin_lat)/(1+e*sin_lat)))
    return x,y

def merc_inv(x,y,a=6378137.0,b=None,f=None,lat_ts=None,k0=1.0):
    if b is None and f is None:
        f=1/298.257222101
    if b is not None:
        if abs(b-a)<1e-6:
            e=0
            e2=0
        else:
            e2=1-(b*b)/(a*a)
            e=math.sqrt(e2)
    elif f is not None:
        e2=2*f-f*f
        e=math.sqrt(e2)
    else:
        e=0
        e2=0
    if lat_ts is not None:
        lat_ts_rad=math.radians(lat_ts)
        if e==0:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)
        else:
            k0_ts=math.cos(lat_ts_rad)/math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_ts_rad)**2)
        k0=k0_ts
    lon_rad=x/(a*k0)
    lon_deg=math.degrees(lon_rad)
    if e==0:
        lat_rad=2*math.atan(math.exp(y/(a*k0)))-math.pi/2
        lat_deg=math.degrees(lat_rad)
    else:
        t=math.exp(-y/(a*k0))
        lat_rad=math.pi/2-2*math.atan(t)
        for _ in range(20):
            sin_lat=math.sin(lat_rad)
            factor=((1-e*sin_lat)/(1+e*sin_lat))**(e/2)
            lat_new=math.pi/2-2*math.atan(t*factor)
            if abs(lat_new-lat_rad)<1e-12:
                lat_rad=lat_new
                break
            lat_rad=lat_new
        lat_deg=math.degrees(lat_rad)
    return lon_deg, lat_deg

    if proj_name in req_map:

        need=False

    def get_v_desc():
        lines=LP_EXP.splitlines()
        for idx,l in enumerate(lines):
            if l.startswith(proj_name+" :"):
                des=[]
                parts=l.split(':',1)
                if len(parts)==2:
                    des.append(f"#{parts[1].strip()}")
                j=idx+1
                while j < len(lines) and lines[j].startswith('\t'):
                    des.append(f"#{lines[j]}")
                    j+=1
                proj_str_parts=proj_opts[:]
                if not any('break_cs2cs_recursion' in p for p in proj_str_parts):
                    proj_str_parts.append('+break_cs2cs_recursion')
                has_ellps=any('ellps' in p or 'a=' in p or 'b=' in p or 'R=' in p for p in proj_str_parts)
                if not has_ellps:
                    proj_str_parts.append('+ellps=GRS80')
                des.append("# "+" ".join(proj_str_parts))
                return "\n".join(des)+"\n"
        return f"#{proj_name}\n# +proj={proj_name}\n"

    def parse_ascii_line(line):
        orig=line.rstrip('\n')
        if orig.strip().startswith('#'):
            return ('comment', orig)
        if not orig.strip():
            return ('coords', 0.0, 0.0, "", "", orig)
        tokens=orig.strip().split()
        if len(tokens)>=2:
            try:
                lon=parse_dms(tokens[0])
                lat=parse_dms(tokens[1])
                orig_num=f"{tokens[0]} {tokens[1]}"
                label=" ".join(tokens[2:]) if len(tokens)>2 else ""
                return ('coords', lon, lat, label, orig_num, orig)
            except:
                return ('coords', 0.0, 0.0, orig.strip(), "", orig)
        else:
            return ('coords', 0.0, 0.0, orig.strip(), "", orig)

    def process_ascii():
        streams=[]
        if not files:
            streams.append(sys.stdin)
        else:
            for fn in files:
                if fn=='-':
                    streams.append(sys.stdin)
                else:
                    if not os.path.exists(fn):
                        err_sys_file(fn)
                    streams.append(open(fn,'r'))
        for stream in streams:
            for raw in stream:
                parsed=parse_ascii_line(raw)
                if parsed[0]=='comment':
                    sys.stdout.write(parsed[1]+"\n")
                    continue
                _, lon, lat, label, orig_num, orig_line = parsed
                if flags['r']:
                    lon,lat=lat,lon
                if flags['m'] is not None:
                    if not inverse:
                        lon*=m_factor
                        lat*=m_factor
                    else:
                        if m_factor!=0:

                            lat/=m_factor
                is_err=False

                                except:
                                    pass
                            k0=1.0
                            if 'k' in proj_dict:
                                try:
                                    k0=float(proj_dict['k'])
                                except:
                                    pass
                            if 'k_0' in proj_dict:
                                try:
                                    k0=float(proj_dict['k_0'])
                                except:
                                    pass
                            x_out,y_out=merc_fwd(lon,lat,a=a,b=b,f=f,lat_ts=lat_ts,k0=k0)
                        elif proj_name=='webmerc':
                            x_out,y_out=merc_fwd(lon,lat,a=6378137.0,b=6378137.0,k0=1.0)
                        else:
                            a,b,f=get_ellipsoid(proj_dict)
                            x_out,y_out=merc_fwd(lon,lat,a=a,b=b,f=f)
                    else:
                        a,b,f=get_ellipsoid(proj_dict)
                        lat_ts=None
                        if 'lat_ts' in proj_dict:
                            try:
                                lat_ts=float(proj_dict['lat_ts'])
                            except:
                                pass
                        k0=1.0
                        if 'k' in proj_dict:
                            try:
                                k0=float(proj_dict['k'])
                            except:
                                pass
                        if 'k_0' in proj_dict:
                            try:
                                k0=float(proj_dict['k_0'])
                            except:
                                pass
                        if proj_name=='merc':
                            x_out,y_out=merc_inv(lon,lat,a=a,b=b,f=f,lat_ts=lat_ts,k0=k0)
                        elif proj_name=='webmerc':
                            x_out,y_out=merc_inv(lon,lat,a=6378137.0,b=6378137.0,k0=1.0)
                        else:
                            x_out,y_out=merc_inv(lon,lat,a=a,b=b,f=f)
                    if x_out is None or y_out is None or math.isinf(x_out) or math.isinf(y_out) or math.isnan(x_out) or math.isnan(y_out):
                        is_err=True
                except Exception as e:
                    is_err=True
                    sys.stderr.write(f"{proj_name}: Invalid latitude\n")
                if flags['s'] and not is_err:
                    x_out,y_out=y_out,x_out
                if flags['V']:

                        pass
                    else:
                        a,b,f=get_ellipsoid(proj_dict)

                        if is_sphere:
                            sys.stdout.write(f"#Final Earth figure: sphere\n#  Radius: {a:.3f}\n")
                        else:
                            if f is None:
                                if b is not None:
                                    f=(a-b)/a
                                else:
                                    f=1/298.257222101
                            rf=1/f if f!=0 else 0
                            e2=2*f-f*f
                            sys.stdout.write(f"#Final Earth figure: ellipsoid\n#  Major axis (a): {a:.3f}\n#  1/flattening: {rf:.6f}\n#  squared eccentricity: {e2:.12f}\n")
                        lon_dms=format_dms_compact(lon, True, None)
                        lat_dms=format_dms_compact(lat, False, None)
                        sys.stdout.write(f"Longitude: {lon_dms} [ {lon:g} ]\n")
                        sys.stdout.write(f"Latitude:  {lat_dms} [ {lat:g} ]\n")
                        if f_fmt is not None:
                            xs=fmt_float(x_out, f_fmt)
                            ys=fmt_float(y_out, f_fmt)
                        elif d_prec is not None:
                            fmt=f"%.{d_prec}f"
                            xs=fmt_float(x_out, fmt)
                            ys=fmt_float(y_out, fmt)
                        else:
                            xs=fmt_float(x_out, "%.2f")
                            ys=fmt_float(y_out, "%.2f")
                        sys.stdout.write(f"Easting (x):   {xs}\n")
                        sys.stdout.write(f"Northing (y):  {ys}\n")
                        try:
                            lat_r=math.radians(lat)
                            cos_lat=math.cos(lat_r)
                            k=1/cos_lat if abs(cos_lat)>1e-12 else float('inf')
                            if f is not None:
                                e2=2*f-f*f
                                k=k*math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_r)**2)
                            h=k
                            s=h*k
                            w=0
                            sys.stdout.write(f"Meridian scale (h) : {h:.8f}  ( 0 % error )\n")
                            sys.stdout.write(f"Parallel scale (k) : {k:.8f}  ( 0 % error )\n")
