                            sys.stdout.write(f"Convergence : 0d [ -0.00000000 ]\n")
                            sys.stdout.write(f"Max-min (Tissot axis a-b) scale error: {h:.5f} {k:.5f}\n\n")
                        except:
                            sys.stdout.write(f"Meridian scale (h) : 1.00000000  ( 0 % error )\n")
                            sys.stdout.write(f"Parallel scale (k) : 1.00000000  ( 0 % error )\n")
                            sys.stdout.write(f"Areal scale (s):     1.00000000  ( 0 % error )\n")
                            sys.stdout.write(f"Angular distortion (w): 0.000\n")
                            sys.stdout.write(f"Meridian/Parallel angle: 90.00000\n")
                            sys.stdout.write(f"Convergence : 0d [ -0.00000000 ]\n")
                            sys.stdout.write(f"Max-min (Tissot axis a-b) scale error: 1.00000 1.00000\n\n")
                    continue
                if is_err:
                    if binary_output:
                        sys.stdout.buffer.write(struct.pack('<dd', float('inf'), float('inf')))
                    else:
                        if e_str is not None:
                            sys.stdout.write(f"{e_str}\n")
                        else:
                            if label:
                                sys.stdout.write(f"*\t* {label}\n")
                            else:
                                sys.stdout.write("*\t*\n")
                    continue
                if binary_output:

                else:

                        ys=fmt_float(y_out, f_fmt)

                    else:

                                lat_s=format_dms_verbose(y_out, False, W_val)
                                out_line=f"{lon_s}\t{lat_s}"
                            elif w_val is not None:
                                lon_s=format_dms_compact(x_out, True, w_val)
                                lat_s=format_dms_compact(y_out, False, w_val)
                                out_line=f"{lon_s}\t{lat_s}"
                            else:
                                lon_s=format_dms_compact(x_out, True, None)
                                lat_s=format_dms_compact(y_out, False, None)
                                out_line=f"{lon_s}\t{lat_s}"
                        else:
                            out_line=f"{fmt_float(x_out, '%.2f')}\t{fmt_float(y_out, '%.2f')}"
                    if flags['S']:
                        try:
                            if proj_name=='merc':
                                lat_r=math.radians(lat)
                                cos_lat=math.cos(lat_r)

                                a_tmp,b_tmp,f_tmp=get_ellipsoid(proj_dict)
                                if f_tmp is not None:
                                    e2=2*f_tmp-f_tmp*f_tmp
                                    k=k*math.sqrt(1-e2*math.sin(lat_r)**2)
                                h=k
                                s=h*k
                                w=0
                                out_line+=f"\t<{h:g} {k:g} {s:g} {w:g} {h:g} {k:g}>"
                            else:
                                out_line+=f"\t<1 1 1 0 1 1>"
                        except:
                            out_line+=f"\t<1 1 1 0 1 1>"
                    if flags['E']:
                        echo_part=orig_num if orig_num else orig_line

                            sys.stdout.write(f"{echo_part}\t{out_line} {label}\n")

    def process_binary():
        if not files:
            data=sys.stdin.buffer.read()
            offset=0
            while offset+16 <= len(data):
                chunk=data[offset:offset+16]
                offset+=16
                try:
                    a1,b1=struct.unpack('<dd', chunk)
                except:
                    a1,b1=struct.unpack('dd', chunk)
                lon=a1
                lat=b1
                if flags['r']:
                    lon,lat=lat,lon
                if flags['m'] is not None:
                    if not inverse:
                        lon*=m_factor
                        lat*=m_factor
                    else:

                            lat/=m_factor

                            raise ValueError

                        x_out,y_out=merc_inv(lon,lat,*get_ellipsoid(proj_dict))
                        x_out=math.radians(x_out)
                        y_out=math.radians(y_out)
                    if math.isinf(x_out) or math.isinf(y_out):
                        is_err=True
                except:
                    is_err=True
                    sys.stderr.write(f"{proj_name}: Invalid latitude\n")
                if flags['s'] and not is_err:
                    x_out,y_out=y_out,x_out
                if is_err:
                    sys.stdout.buffer.write(struct.pack('<dd', float('inf'), float('inf')))
                else:
                    if binary_output:
                        sys.stdout.buffer.write(struct.pack('<dd', x_out, y_out))
                    else:
                        if not inverse:
                            if f_fmt is not None:
                                xs=fmt_float(x_out, f_fmt)
                                ys=fmt_float(y_out, f_fmt)
                                sys.stdout.write(f"{xs}\t{ys}\n")
                            elif d_prec is not None:
                                fmt=f"%.{d_prec}f"
                                sys.stdout.write(f"{fmt_float(x_out, fmt)}\t{fmt_float(y_out, fmt)}\n")
                            else:
                                sys.stdout.write(f"{fmt_float(x_out, '%.2f')}\t{fmt_float(y_out, '%.2f')}\n")
                        else:
                            lon_deg=math.degrees(x_out)

                            if f_fmt is not None:

                            elif d_prec is not None:
                                fmt=f"%.{d_prec}f"
                                sys.stdout.write(f"{fmt_float(lon_deg, fmt)}\t{fmt_float(lat_deg, fmt)}\n")
                            else:
                                if W_val is not None:
                                    lon_s=format_dms_verbose(lon_deg, True, W_val)
                                    lat_s=format_dms_verbose(lat_deg, False, W_val)
                                    sys.stdout.write(f"{lon_s}\t{lat_s}\n")
                                elif w_val is not None:
                                    lon_s=format_dms_compact(lon_deg, True, w_val)
                                    lat_s=format_dms_compact(lat_deg, False, w_val)
                                    sys.stdout.write(f"{lon_s}\t{lat_s}\n")
                                else:
                                    lon_s=format_dms_compact(lon_deg, True, None)
                                    lat_s=format_dms_compact(lat_deg, False, None)
                                    sys.stdout.write(f"{lon_s}\t{lat_s}\n")
        else:
            for fn in files:

                else:
                    if not os.path.exists(fn):
                        err_sys_file(fn)
                    with open(fn,'rb') as f:

                offset=0
                while offset+16 <= len(data):
                    chunk=data[offset:offset+16]
                    offset+=16
                    try:
